info.name: Acquia Content API
info.description: The stable JSON:API surface shared by every Source CMS site, plus the OAuth 2.0 authentication endpoints that issue the tokens it accepts.

variable.description: (Required) An entity type machine name (for example `node`, `media`, `taxonomy_term`).

(Required) A bundle machine name (for example `article`). The [content model reference](/source-cms/reference/content-model/#entity-types-and-bundles) maps each entity type to its bundle term and endpoint pattern.
(Required) The entry's UUID, the `id` member of every response.
(Required) A relationship field machine name.

request.description: The referenced entries themselves, with full attributes, that a relationship field points at.

response.name: A JSON:API document of the related entries.
